correctness.rationale: Every target divides into ordinary reciprocal cost-two pair or alternating reciprocal cost-one pair. A spanning tour must depart each pair, forcing sharp cost (5q²−q)/2; a path can terminate in just one pair, giving one more symbol. The balanced connected explicit Euler construction joins all modules via exact cost-three transitions. A stdlib verifier checked constructions q=2..30 and independent exact Hamiltonian DP q=2,4. All-q validity rests on this combinatorial proof.
